question: What happens when one established in the non-conceptual enters by any path?
premises: One may be established on the non-conceptual path.
From that standpoint one may enter through any path from earth up to Sadāśiva.
Every such entry leads to becoming Śiva.
inference: For one grounded in the non-conceptual, any level of the cosmic range can serve as a path to Śiva-identity.
plain_english: One who is established on the non-conceptual path, by whatever path one enters, from earth up to Sadāśiva, by that very path one becomes Śiva.
